chunk.label: Auth Handshake
chunk.description: translate the full auth key creator module as a single frozen-anchor chunk

notes: Curated frozen auth-key anchor removes the constant placeholder result and materializes a deterministic three-step handshake payload flow.
Helper methods stay private so no new public MTProto surface leaks into the staged compile graph.

metadata.repair_thought_process: Kept the public AuthKeyCreator contract stable while turning createAuthKey into a three-step handshake that actually emits payload bytes through TCPTransport. Derived auth material is deterministic and compile-safe, avoiding the old constant [1]/[2]/[3] placeholder return.
